title: GOOD: iterative DP glob matcher prevents ReDoS in IMAP LIST
description: stoa-imap mailbox.rs glob_bytes() implements mailbox glob matching with an iterative O(m*n) DP algorithm rather than a compiled regex or recursive backtracker. This prevents exponential backtracking (ReDoS) from adversarial mailbox patterns. Correct design; do not replace with a regex-based matcher.
